240-1879-5470-8249.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-5670-5708--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-5670-5708--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

880-5478-7885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5478-7885.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When the land enters the battlefield, Down in the Valley triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3821-4770-5542.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}.
3821-4770-5542.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2334-4872-7722.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Soulherder.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Warp from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Warp from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

3263-4762-7394.notablePrerequisites: You have six or more experience counters.
3263-4762-7394.description:
Activate Azlask by paying {5}, giving each creature you control +1/+1 until end of turn for each experience counter you have.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 four additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-7175-7291.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-7175-7291.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

1477-6837-6871-6879.description:
Cast Three Tree Mascot by paying {2}.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Three Tree Mascot.
When Three Tree Mascot dies, Haru triggers, returning Three Tree Mascot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Three Tree Mascot enters, Haru triggers, targeting Three Tree Mascot as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

645-1267-6798-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-6798-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with exactly two lore counters on it

974-1305-4417-5090-6674.easyPrerequisites: Rydia does not have summoning sickness.
974-1305-4417-5090-6674.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it and triggering its third chapter ability, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Rydia by paying {5} and tapping it, returning There and Back Again from your graveyard to the battlefield with a finality counter on it. As There and Back Again enters the battlefield, choose to have it enter with three lore counters due to its read-ahead ability.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers. Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {1}{B/P}, removing the finality counter from There and Back Again.
Resolve the There and Back Again trigger, creating a 6/6 Smaug legendary creature token and sacrifice There and Back Again.
Put a Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule, triggering its ability, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate thirteen Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {12}{B}.
Activate Singing Bell Strike by paying {6}, untapping Rydia.
Repeat from step 2.

851-1563-2457-3480.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

957-2304-3019-5546.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
957-2304-3019-5546.description:
Cast Inspiring Refrain by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Arcane Bombardment triggers, exiling a random instant or sorcery from your graveyard, and then casting a copy of Time Stretch without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Time Stretch copy, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve Inspiring Refrain, causing you to draw two cards and exile Inspiring Refrain with three time counters on it.
Activate Jhoira's Timebug by tapping it, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain.
Move to your first extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Move to your second extra turn, removing a time counter from Inspiring Refrain during your upkeep.
Inspiring Refrain triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

2178-2921-4147-4215.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Hua Tuo.
2178-2921-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
2178-2921-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession and Hua Tuo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Hua Tuo trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

225-1021-2167-2953.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
Dawn's Reflection attached to any mana-producing land you control.
225-1021-2167-2953.description:
Activate the land with Dawn's Reflection attached by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Dawn's Reflection triggers, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the land.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, adding {C}.
Repeat.

141-313-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-2034.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

852-1624-3625.notablePrerequisites: Vhati il-Dal and Tree of Redemption do not have summoning sickness.
852-1624-3625.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, activate Vhati il-Dal by tapping it, causing Tree of Redemption to have base toughness 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, swapping your life total with Tree of Redemption's toughness.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

878-1651-2751-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power one or greater.
878-1651-2751-4659.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice another creature with power one or greater.
Ziatora triggers, holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ziatora's ability.
Resolve the copy of Ziatora's ability, dealing damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target and creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasure tokens, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Treasure token, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ziatora's ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1171-4068.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

3490-4195-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
3490-4195-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact you control, adding {C}{C}.
Ich-Tekik triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and each Golem you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the remaining Animation Module triggers, choosing not to pay.
 Repeat.

614-1987-2427-4792.description:
Activate Paradise Plume by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Paradise Plume and Nucklavee, blinking them as well as triggering Paradise Plume to gain you 1 life.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Paradise Plume enters the battlefield, choose "blue".
Repeat.
